==Enemies==
'''Hex''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Hex Corpse]], a enemy that divides itself into two parts found in [[The Nightmare Realm|Night II]] and [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
**[[Hex Corpse/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Hex Drako]], a high health enemy found in [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
**[[Hex Drako/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Hex Mimic]], a fast enemy resembling a chest mimic, found in [[The Nightmare Realm|Night II]] and [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
**[[Hex Mimic/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Hex Minion]], a fast but low health enemy found in [[The Nightmare Realm|Night II]] and [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
**[[Hex Minion/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Hex Revenant]], a high defense enemy found in [[The Nightmare Realm|Night II]] and [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
**[[Hex Revenant/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Hex's Maw]], a high health and defense enemy with several immunities found in [[The Nightmare Realm|Night II]] and [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
**[[Hex's Maw/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Hex Spawn]], the first enemy found in [[The Nightmare Realm|Night II]] and [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
**[[Hex Spawn/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Hex Weaver]], a high health enemy found in [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
*[[Hex Wraith]], an average health enemy found in [[The Nightmare Realm|Night II]] and [[Containment|Night III]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]
**[[Hex Wraith/Advanced Stats]]
